structured_output.explanation: The active correction commit says Claude Code collapses every non-alphanumeric UTF-16 code unit to a dash, with no NFC normalization. It also says the fallback decoder recovers posix, drive-letter and UNC prefixes. The implementation matches all of this. encode_project emits one dash per UTF-16 unit for each non-ASCII-alphanumeric character. decode_project handles UNC, drive-letter and posix slugs, and its lossiness is accepted. The old plan is only a future proposal, so its NFC and MSIX claims are not active promises.
